notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: a state listing, a TopoQuest location entry (elevation 1640 ft, matching the 500 m in the record) and an OpenStreetMap point. Two web searches found no Harmony-specific history. Results kept returning other Price County towers, which are not this one and were not used: Fifield (National Register NR2273, built 1932), Lugerville and Park Falls (Case Ave, 1951). A Central US Lookouts page for Harmony returned 404. Confidence is low and the story is well under the 120-word target; a human should check Wisconsin Historical Society site files or DNR records before publishing.
